title.value: The Harbin Rotarian, No. 49, October 31st, 1936

summary: Monthly bulletin of the Rotary Club of Harbin with attendance statistics for October 1936 and minutes of the meetings of 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29 October. large credit.

This was what Rotarian Kaufman told us
about the business life of Shanghai.

This report was translated by the secre-
tary Mr. ”Marble’” Gundsi into the Japanese
language.

Rotarian Minsky thanked Rotarian Kauf-

man for his interesting report after which

Rotarian ’Taddy” Kawasumi read the per-
centage of attendance,

It was decided that the Family Night of
the Harbin Rotary Club will take place
on the 24th of April and the meeting will
start at 8,30, We hope to have as many
Rotarians with their ladies that the hall of
the Nichiman Club can hold.

April 24th, 1937.

The Family Night meeting of the Harbin
Rotary Club was opened By President
*Duty” Ehara at 8.30. There were many
guests at the meeting among whom we
must mention the manes of the Council
General of Japan Mr. S. Sato with his wife,
the secretary of the Japanese Consulate,
and many others who came to congratulate
us with the 7ih anniversary of the Club.

Rotarians with their wives were in great
number.

Our Chairman, President ’’Duty” Ekara
made-a speech thanking our guests for
their presense and said a few words about
the foundation of the Club here. He also
informed us that this year the number of
Rotary Clubs has greatly increased. In our
70th district we have also some new clubs
which gives us a great pleasure. He hoped
that the work of Harbin Rotary Club will
go on as it did before and that its mem-
bers would do some good work. With that
he again thanked our visitors for their
kind attention and presence at our meeting.

Our secretary Rotarian Marble” Gundsi
read the report about the activities of the
Rotary Club of the passed year which was

translated into Japanese language.

Rotarian Ostroumoff too noted the grown
of Rotary Clubs. Where last year we had
4000 Rotary Clubs this year we already
have 4200. All the countries have Rotary
Clubs-in them and the only sad exception
is the Soviet Russia.

The Ideas of the Rotary Club are very
simple. Rotary gives the possibility of
mutual understanding. It developes a strong
will. It makes people understand different
professions.

People are strongly connected with each
other. Rotarians of One Club are frequently
seen in the Rotary Clubs of different cities.
They visit conferenses, Last time it was
America, next time it will be in Nice.

The chief idea of the Rotary Club is
Service. The idea of self improvement.
International work, and mutual understan-
ding. These are the ideas of Rotary and
we try to bring them to life the best we
can,

The health of every Rotarian was_pro-
posed and the meeting began to be very
gay.

Several other speeches were made. By
Mrs. Kusic who thanked the Rotarians for
their hospitality, by Rotarian Schweyer and
by many others.

Translations were made by Rotarians
Gundsi and Kawasumi.

The meeting continued till late hours.
There was a nice Japanese and Russian
programm and everyone went home _ thin-
king that the time went too quickly.

The following letter was re-

Cleveland (Ohio) Reminder:

Will you please convey
to the Rotary Club the
very deep thanks of the
University Settlement
members for the Rotary
contribution to us this
year.

As you know, we have
lacked equipment for a
workshop where neighbor-
hood youth and their
parents can together
build useful articles
and can learn program
planning and skills for
the express purpose of
taking them back to
their neighborhood or-
ganizations. This is a
neighborhood project.
